name: Grant App Permissions
description: Grant privacy permissions (camera, photos, location, etc.) to an iOS app without UI prompts

steps.script: do shell script "xcrun simctl privacy booted grant all {bundleId}"
steps.description: Grant ALL permissions to app (replace {bundleId}). Or use specific: camera, photos, location, microphone, contacts, calendars, reminders, health, homekit, speech-recognition

notes: To revoke: xcrun simctl privacy booted revoke all {bundleId}. To reset: xcrun simctl privacy booted reset all {bundleId}
